objective: measure whether the quarantined medical rule pool contains salvageable strata under the Phase A safety gate

method.sampling: 50 records for each of five non-empty medical categories plus 50 general records; source-half and token-bin quotas; fixed hash seed
method.review: deterministic forensic signal scan over all 300 records plus internal research review of confirmed category examples

reasons: question-answer mismatch: chemotherapy interval question receives unrelated lumbar/kidney-stone diagnosis and treatment advice
unsupported diagnosis plus dangerous certainty: serology is presented as a diagnosis and major treatment is dismissed without clinical context
specific multi-drug prescription for nocturnal emissions without evidence or patient assessment
pancreatic cancer cost question receives specific chemotherapy/radiotherapy and cost guidance without evidence
acute-stroke drug list includes antiplatelet and injectable combinations without contraindication or time-window caveats
stromal-tumor answer recommends unverified Chinese-medicine treatment and unsupported survival claims
pediatric-sexual-history context receives drug, enema, physiotherapy, imaging and surgery advice without assessment
malformed premature-ejaculation question receives adult diagnostic claims and a claim that targeted treatment can fully cure the condition
brain-tumour treatment question is answered with pseudoscientific acidosis/parasite claims and certain recovery language
vaginal-discharge question is spliced with unrelated schistosomiasis treatment text
brain-atrophy answer states that treatment is generally unnecessary while inferring possible dementia from symptoms

gate_applied.critical_issue_rule: any confirmed key safety issue rejects the whole stratum
gate_applied.result: all five medical strata rejected before a salvage-token estimate is allowed

pilot_evidence.finding: pilot already observed garbled text, unsupported diagnosis, incorrect treatment/testing advice, template misassembly and unreliable prognosis

recommendation_details: do not use old rule-pool medical answers as supervised training text
retain only question intent structures as references for evidence-bound API generation
do not force the medical token quota if authoritative evidence does not support it
limitations: this is an internal engineering and research audit, not clinician review or clinical validation
forensic signal counts are conservative text-pattern indicators, not an estimate of diagnostic accuracy
the general stratum was retained based on 50 records; later pipeline checks must still verify leakage, duplication and manifest contracts
